name: side-menu
summary: The in-module SECTION navigation panel — a searchable, collapsible left menu. ONE element with a `mode` axis folding the product's four side-menu forms: sections (settings sub-nav, 20×), categories (dashboard picker, count tags), tree (Log/Topology N-level hierarchy with type icon + count badge), and list (report/saved-views flat list, optional ★ favourite). Data-driven via a recursive `items` model; optional top segmented `tabs` + a search box. The active leaf highlights --primary on --code-tag-background-color (sections adds a --primary left rule). NOT the module rail (obs-sidebar), NOT sibling views (obs-tabs), NOT the faceted checkbox filter (a vertical Filter). SIZING: the element is width:100% (fills its container) — set the container WIDTH per mode (sections ~15% / categories ~30vw / tree|list ~20%); see `sizing` + usageRules[mode].width.

variants.name: sections
variants.what: icon + name accordion → sub-items (settings left-menu); active leaf gets a --primary left rule

variants.name: categories
variants.what: category groups WITH count tags → child items (dashboard picker)

variants.name: tree
variants.what: N-level hierarchy — node = a monitor-type LOGO + name + a numeric (JetBrains Mono) count pill (Log Explorer log-item.vue / Topology)

variants.name: list
variants.what: a flat list with an active highlight + optional ★ favourite (report / saved-views)

variants.name: with-tabs
variants.what: a segmented tab strip above the panel (Dashboard/NOC · Metric/Log/Flow…)

variants.name: with-search
variants.what: a search box that filters (and auto-expands) the tree (default on)

sizes.name: fill
sizes.note: the element fills its container — set the width via your layout column. In the product these are RESIZABLE splitter panes sized by percentage, not fixed px.

sizes.name: sections
sizes.note: Settings left-menu: a <Pane :size="15" min-size="15"> (~215–290px on a 1440–1920 screen).

sizes.name: tree
sizes.note: Log/Topology explorer rail: a resizable splitpanes pane (~250–360px; ~340px fixed).

sizes.name: list
sizes.note: Report / saved-views rail: a resizable pane (~250–360px; ~340px fixed).

states.name: group
states.what: a collapsible node — chevron + optional icon + label + optional count; click toggles expand

states.name: leaf-active
states.what: the selected leaf — --primary on --code-tag-background-color (sections: + inset left rule)

mode.note: sections (icon accordion) · categories (count-tag groups) · tree (N-level hierarchy) · list (flat).

items.note: the recursive menu model — a JSON array of {label, icon?, logo?, count?, favorite?, edit?, children?}. `icon` is an obs-icon name; `logo` is a monitor-type LOGO — a NAME renders (e.g. router/linux/windows), a URL/data-URI renders an — and takes precedence over `icon`. `count` renders an obs-tag (tree adds numeric/JetBrains-Mono). A node with `children` is a collapsible group; a leaf is selectable.

active.note: the active leaf `label` — highlighted (--primary; sections adds a --primary left rule; list uses weight 500). Seeds the initial highlight AND expands its ancestor groups; clicking any leaf moves the highlight (internal state) and emits `select`.

search.note: show the search box (filters + auto-expands matches).

tabs.note: optional segmented tabs above the panel — a JSON array of {label,value} (or strings).

active-tab.note: the selected tab value (defaults to the first).

tab-style.note: tab presentation — underline (tree/list) or segmented (categories Dashboard/NOC switcher).

events.select: ({label}) — a leaf item was chosen (wire it to filter the grid/route).

slots.tabs-action: an action to the right of the tabs (e.g. a ＋).
slots.search-action: an action to the right of the search (e.g. a layout toggle).
slots.logo: optional branding/header slot at the very top (a logo or section title) — adds no height when unused.
slots.default: the default (footer) slot at the bottom, below the list — e.g. a "+ New Category" action. Adds no height when unused.

decisionFlow: Navigate SECTIONS within a module (Settings sub-nav; expand to sub-items)? -> obs-side-menu mode="sections".
A category picker with COUNTS (Dashboard categories → dashboards)? -> mode="categories".
An N-level HIERARCHY with type icons + counts (Log types, Topology tree)? -> mode="tree".
A flat LIST of saved views / reports (optional favourites)? -> mode="list".
Switch between top-level MODULES? -> obs-sidebar, NOT the side-menu.
Switch between sibling VIEWS of the same page? -> obs-tabs.
A faceted CHECKBOX filter panel? -> a vertical Filter (Filters family), not a side-menu.

sections.useWhen: an in-module section nav that expands to sub-items (Settings-style)
sections.dontUse: top-level module switching (obs-sidebar) or sibling views (obs-tabs)
sections.example: Settings: General / Monitoring / Users & Roles → sub-items, Monitoring expanded
sections.width: WIDTH: wrap it in ~15% of the viewport (~215–290px; use ~260px if fixed) — the narrow Settings rail.

categories.useWhen: grouped items with counts, expand to children (dashboard picker)
categories.dontUse: a flat list (use list) or a deep hierarchy (use tree)
categories.width: WIDTH: wrap it in ~30vw (~430–580px; use ~500px if fixed) — the WIDEST (dashboard picker).

tree.useWhen: a multi-level hierarchy where nodes carry a type icon + a count (log types, topology)
tree.width: WIDTH: wrap it in ~15–25% of the viewport (~250–360px; use ~340px if fixed) — an explorer rail.

list.useWhen: a flat list of saved views / reports, one active, optional favourites
list.width: WIDTH: wrap it in ~15–25% of the viewport (~250–360px; use ~340px if fixed) — a report / saved-views rail.

with-tabs.useWhen: the panel switches between named scopes (Dashboard/NOC, Metric/Log/Flow)
with-tabs.example: Metric / Log / Flow / Trap / Audit tabs above a saved-views list

with-search.useWhen: the list is long enough to need filtering (default on)

surface.useWhen: always — the in-module side menu is a FLUSH WHITE panel (var(--common-widget-bg)); it fills its column edge-to-edge.
surface.dontUse: a gray/tinted surface or a rounded bordered card. Do NOT wrap it in a gray container, and do NOT set its background to --page-background-color / --common-main-bg (those are the PAGE, which is grey in a real app — the menu would go gray).
surface.must: keep it white and flush with a RIGHT divider only (border-right) — no card border/radius. Matches the product settings menu (full-height column separated from content by a right border).
surface.example: <obs-side-menu mode="sections" items="..."></obs-side-menu> in a full-height left column — white, borderless.

do: Render it as a flush WHITE panel (it uses --common-widget-bg) filling its column — don’t put it on a gray surface or in a rounded card.
Pick the `mode` for the shape of your data (sections/categories/tree/list).
Feed a recursive `items` model; set `active` to the current leaf; child items may carry an `icon`.
Reuse the header slots for mode chrome — `tabs-action` (＋), `search-action` (toggle); the search is a real obs-input.
Wire `select` to filter the grid/route; `tab`/`search` as needed.

Set the panel WIDTH via your layout column — the element is width:100%. In the product these are resizable panes (Settings ~15%, Dashboard ~30vw, explorers ~20%); don't hardcode a fixed px unless your layout is fixed.
dont: Don’t give the side menu a gray background or a rounded/bordered card — it’s a flush white panel (product = background:none, radius:0).
Don't use it for top-level modules (obs-sidebar) or sibling views (obs-tabs).
Don't use it as a faceted checkbox filter — that's a vertical Filter.
Don't hand-roll the accordion/tree — reuse obs-side-menu.
Don't hardcode colours — active is --primary on --code-tag-background-color.

a11y.summary: A role=tree of role=treeitem rows; groups expose aria-expanded; the active leaf is highlighted. Tabs are role=tab/tablist with aria-selected. The search is a real <input type=search>. Keyboard: rows/tabs are clickable; (full arrow-key tree nav is a consumer enhancement).

issues.issue: Arrow-key roving tabindex across the tree is not built in — add it if the panel is a primary keyboard surface.
Verify a visible focus ring on rows/tabs against the panel surface in both themes.

knownIssues.issue: obs-side-menu is a render-faithful reproduction of the four product side-menu forms (the live trees are store/worker/virtualised — infinite-tree.vue). Virtualisation, inline rename (pencil), create/delete affordances, and the router/filter wiring are the consumer's; obs-side-menu provides the searchable accordion/tree chrome + select/tab/search events.

changelog.change: Dark theme: panel background now #07101f via new token --side-menu-bg (light stays white #fff). Added a theme-aware scrollbar (--utility-scrollbar-thumb) so the scroll region no longer shows the browsers bright default bar on the dark surface.

changelog: 2026-08-09 — Discoverability (gap G0): added a routing selectHint + keywords (left nav, category list, saved views, section/settings menu) so search_components finds obs-side-menu by its obvious phrasings instead of returning the family guide.

2026-08-09 — Slots (consumer G10 follow-up): added a `logo` header slot (top) and a `default` footer slot (bottom, e.g. a "+ New Category" action) — both add zero height when unfilled. Previously only tabs-action/search-action existed, so consumers hand-built the footer.

2026-08-06 — Added the persistent RIGHT border (border-right: 1px --border-color) to the flush white panel — the product settings menu is a full-height column divided from the content by a right rule. (Still no card border/radius.)

2026-08-06 — Surface fix (owner): the panel used var(--page-background-color) + a 1px border + 6px radius (a card). In a real app --page-background-color is the grey content area, so the menu rendered GREY; and the product settings menu is actually flush (left-list.less: background:none, radius:0). Switched to a flush WHITE panel: background var(--common-widget-bg) (stays white on any page), removed the outer border + radius. Added a `surface` usageRule + do/dont so AI tools keep it white & flush, not a gray card.
2026-07-26 — Docs accuracy pass (owner): synced tokensUsed to the tokens the element actually resolves. Reuse (obs-* composition) / props / variants / a11y verified current — no drift. No API change.

changelog.change: Completeness pass: the component ships every variant (sections · categories · tree · list) with full functionality — reused sub-components (obs-input search, obs-tabs / obs-radio as-button tabs, obs-button ＋/toggle, obs-icon, obs-logo type logos, obs-tag counts), search filter + auto-expand, expand/collapse, click-to-select, per-mode chrome, and the width-sizing contract (sizing{} + usageRules[mode].width). Props/usage/decisionFlow/a11y/known-issues all current.

Made the width contract AI-actionable: added usageRules[mode].width (per-mode width right where the AI picks the mode), a top-level `sizing` object (model + byMode + rule), split the sizes tree/list into per-mode entries, and stated the width model in the summary. An AI picking any mode now sees the exact width to define.

Documented the real width model — obs-side-menu is width:100% (fills its container); the product panels are RESIZABLE percentage panes (Settings 15%, Dashboard 30vw, explorers ~20%), not fixed px. Retuned the showcase demo widths to those proportions (Sections ~260, Categories ~500, Tree/List ~340).
List variant: the active item is now font-weight 500 (was 600) — matching the real product .selection-menu selected weight (the story reproduction had used 600).

Tree type nodes now REUSE the new obs-logo element (<obs-logo name="router|linux|windows">) instead of an inlined data-URI — a `logo` item field accepts a logo NAME (→ obs-logo, the logos library) or a URL/data-URI (→ img).
Tree count now REUSES obs-tag with a new `numeric` option (JetBrains Mono) instead of a hand-styled span — so every count is the obs-tag component (tree = numeric mono, categories = regular).

Tree variant, transcribed from log-item.vue: type nodes now render the real monitor-type LOGO (Router/Linux/Windows from the logos library, via a new `logo` item field / image), not a monochrome icon; and the count is the product .numeric-value — JetBrains Mono (--numeric-font-family), tabular figures, a muted rounded pill — replacing the tag-primary obs-tag for tree (categories keeps obs-tag). Data matched to the real Log Explorer.

Icon sizing (owner review vs product): bumped the menu icons to match the product — group/type icons 14→19px (the product .list-icon is 1.3rem/~20px), leaf item icons 14→16px, chevrons 10→12px, favourite star 13→16px. They were too small.

Reuse + interaction fixes (owner review, verified vs product): count badges now REUSE obs-tag (rounded tag-primary — the product dashboard-dropdown uses MTag rounded tag-primary), replacing the hand-built span (also bigger, as expected). The search-action toggle button now matches the search height (both 35px, via --input-height-base). Clicking any leaf now moves the active highlight (internal active state seeded from the `active` prop) — so List (and every mode) is selectable.

Reuse + fidelity pass (owner review): the tab strip now REUSES obs-tabs (underline, tree/list) and obs-radio as-button (the segmented Dashboard/NOC switcher, categories) instead of hand-built tabs; search reuses obs-input, ＋/toggle reuse obs-button, all glyphs obs-icon. Group headers now show the SAME hover background as child rows (--nav-hover-bg). Panels widened and the segmented switcher fills the header.

Fidelity pass (owner review): rebuilt each mode from its product source instead of a generic model. sections rows crisped to 9px/6px; categories now uses a SEGMENTED Dashboard/NOC switcher (tab-style) + a `tabs-action` ＋ slot + a `search-action` toggle slot + child icons; tree/list use UNDERLINE tabs with type icons + count badges (tree) / border-split rows + ★ favourite + weight-600 active + hover pencil (list). Search now reuses obs-input; ＋/toggle reuse obs-button; group headers no longer show a hover background; panels widened. New `tab-style` prop (underline|segmented).

Added obs-side-menu — the in-module section panel, ONE element with a `mode` axis (sections · categories · tree · list) folding the four product side-menu forms. Recursive `items` model, optional segmented `tabs` + a filtering/auto-expanding search, active-leaf highlight (--primary; sections adds a left rule). Emits select/search/tab; composes obs-icon. Source-derived (the live trees are store/worker-bound). Part of the Navigation-family decomposition (one element per reusable purpose + route-aways).

sizing.model: obs-side-menu is width:100% and fills its container — YOU must set the container width. In the product these are RESIZABLE percentage panes, not fixed px.
sizing.rule: When you pick a mode, wrap <obs-side-menu> in a container of that width (a % pane, or the px in parentheses if your layout is fixed). See usageRules[mode].width.

selectHint: The in-module SECTION / category navigation panel — a left menu / left nav for a module (settings menu, category list, saved-views list, sections/tree). NOT the module rail (obs-sidebar) and NOT sibling views (obs-tabs).
